nodes.name: ReadSubscriptionNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price-increase notice the user received to identify the new price and effective date

nodes.name: ReadMarchTransaction
nodes.role: read the March Spotify payment in the user's transaction history to get the amount actually paid

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: compare the new price that applies to the March charge with the amount actually paid to find the difference owed

nodes.name: ConfirmShortfall
nodes.role: check with the user that the computed difference and the payee are correct before any money moves

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the confirmed difference to Spotify as a payment

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: record the completed payment and its confirmation in the user's transaction history
